title: Revelstoke Museum & Archives

services.name: Audio Tour
services.desc: All tours start at the Museum at 11 am. The guided tours take about 1 hour and focus on the built heritage of Revelstoke's historic downtown. The tour is suitable for children. Tickets are $10 each, and include museum admission. Dress for the weather and wear comfy shoes! Please note that tours may be cancelled or rescheduled in the case of severe weather. Join us for guided tours of Revelstoke's Historic Mountain View Cemetery on Highway 23 North. Children may attend with their parents, but please be aware that there is some adult content. Tickets are $10 each, and include museum admission. Learn about the history of Revelstoke through the Heritage Panels situated throughout Revelstoke.
